owners.05: GA4 receiving/custom dimensions and reviewed publication

authority: AUTHORITY.md; direct owner message verified in03 turn01a1ef0f-4f7a-7811-8d84-155e657817f6

attempt_id.meaning: Random per accepted user action, unrelated to guest/session/booking identity. Correlation only, never register as a high-cardinality GA4 custom dimension.

entry_page.meaning: Page where this action originated; independent of request_kind and may be home for a specific-property request.

page_kind.meaning: Current safe logical screen, not a signed URL. Keep existing URL privacy redaction.

stay_kind.meaning: Only the public overnight journey is instrumented here; do not infer day-use/morning or expand admin tracking.

property_id.meaning: Existing public apartment slug only, never internal property/Hostaway/booking identifiers.

parent_attempt_id.meaning: Random parent portfolio attempt when a new property_quote action follows result selection; never a GA4 custom dimension.

journey_entry.meaning: First known page of the correlated journey; separate from entry_page of current action and page_kind of current screen.

events.name: availability_view
events.trigger: Search form50% visible for1000continuous milliseconds in a visible document, after analytics consent.
events.dedup: Once per tab, screen/property and30minute window; refresh/back within window does not repeat.

events.name: availability_request
events.meaning: User submission accepted by client validation; not server success
events.trigger: At end of submit dispatch, only when not defaultPrevented and native/custom validation allows it. Create correlation before native navigation. Rejected/duplicate submissions emit nothing.
events.dedup: One per accepted click. Explicit retry after completed failure creates a new random attempt; automatic POST refresh keeps the posted token and does not fabricate another client request.

events.name: availability_result_view
events.meaning: Server-classified result became visible, including quote-success redirect
events.trigger: Server renders classification; result summary50% visible for1000continuous milliseconds with consent. Success that redirects to quote detail retains the original attempt context.
events.dedup: Once per attempt/status in the tab; refresh/back/currency reload of the same result does not repeat.

events.name: price_view
events.meaning: A valid positive displayed price became visible, not merely a document or API load
events.trigger: Actual priced DOM element50% visible for1000continuous milliseconds in visible document; valid current quote or ready price component; consent required.
events.dedup: Once per attempt or non-exported surface key, property, context and actual display currency/value within30minutes. Calendar uses one first actually-visible positive nightly-price cell per property/month-grid/currency; changing month-grid may count another visible surface, never a stay quote. Dates/group keys are not exported.

result_status.available: All checks completed, at least one available property with verified price; specific quote successfully created or current valid result.
result_status.unavailable: Specific property definitively unavailable for submitted criteria; no provider error.
result_status.no_results: Portfolio completed without technical errors and no available priced results, including no eligible candidates.
result_status.partial_error: Portfolio has at least one successful available result and at least one technical check failure.
result_status.upstream_error: No available priced results and at least one provider/calendar/pricing verification failure; never label this no_results.
result_status.invalid_request: Server form validation failed; no availability call.
result_status.rate_limited: Server refused request due to rate limiting.
result_status.quote_error: A secure quote could not be prepared after checking; do not label unavailable.

numericRules.nights: positive integer only, no dates exported
numericRules.counts: nonnegative integers from server; missing is omitted, not invented0
numericRules.price: currency/value are the positive finite amount and actual currency rendered. source_currency/source_value separately preserve authority; no amount is invented or summed across currencies.

sourceOfTruth.outcomeAndCounts: server availability result and actual error classification
sourceOfTruth.serverCreation: BookingQuote commit remains a separate backend fact; no new server-to-Google sender or server event in this release
sourceOfTruth.price: single structured money-presentation helper feeds both visible text and measurement attributes, including explicit source-currency fallback
sourceOfTruth.visibility: IntersectionObserver plus document visibility, uninterrupted1000ms dwell; no visibility support means no price/view event, never unconditional fallback

correlationAndPrivacy.serverRedirectBridge: Only safe attempt metadata in the existing owned session, bounded20entries/30minutes and only when analytics consent is valid; no new cookies or URL tokens. No booking authorization derives from measurement fields.
correlationAndPrivacy.unlinkedOldQuote: Valid owned old quote can count a visible price with unknown origin and no fabricated result/request. Use a non-exported opaque DOM surface key for local dedup, never export raw reference.
correlationAndPrivacy.browserStorage: Consent-gated sessionStorage only, bounded and expiring; no cookies/localStorage; withdrawal clears measurement keys and pauses pending observations.
correlationAndPrivacy.lateConsent: Re-arm current visible surfaces without replaying historical requests. Never queue a denied submit for later export. Existing purchase behavior remains unchanged.

transition.legacyWarning: These keep their historical meanings for continuity; never add them to new events or treat quote_created as backend creation. New trusted funnel uses pp1 only. Existing ecommerce is not changed.
transition.receiving: 06 maps only these four new custom events;05 reviews bounded enum dimensions. No attempt_id custom-dimension registration, no new Primary/key event/purchase conversion and no audience/Ads bidding changes.
transition.rollout: 01 candidate implementation plus unit/DOM tests;06/05 explicit contract reviews in local folders; resolve findings; exact-head CI; coordinated compatible publication only after applicable authority and readiness are evidenced.
transition.rollback: Revert the isolated website commit and disable only the four new GTM event mappings/new GA4 definitions as appropriate, preserving consent, purchase, legacy events and booking/payment state.

internalVersusDisplayed: result_status classifies server evaluation; display_status independently labels the actual visible result message. upstream_error maps to verification_error, partial_error to partial_results, and definitive unavailable/no_results remain distinct. Marker must wrap the visible message, not a generic page heading.
optionalResetRule: Every event push resets all pp1 fields (including parent/journey/status/property/value/currency) to null before merging its own sanitized values. Missing optional values remain null in dataLayer, destination tag omits them. Do not infer a missing field from prior model state.
correlationGraph: New property_quote action has a new random attempt_id and optional parent_attempt_id from the portfolio result. journey_entry retains first known journey page; entry_page is the current action origin; page_kind is current screen. Same-tab result-card navigation transfers only consent-gated safe context. Direct property and old owned quote remain unlinked if no verified parent.
